docstring: Computes finite sentinel bounds and duration in seconds for bounded or unbounded intervals.
signature: def compute_interval_duration_and_bounds(start: int | None, end: int | None) -> dict:
ref_implementation:
import sys

NEG_INF = -(sys.maxsize - 1)
POS_INF = sys.maxsize - 1

def compute_interval_duration_and_bounds(start: int | None, end: int | None) -> dict:
    """Computes finite sentinel bounds and duration in seconds for bounded or unbounded intervals.
    None represents unbounded past (-inf) or future (+inf).
    """
    if start is not None and end is not None:
        if start > end:
            raise ValueError(f"Interval start ({start}) must be <= end ({end})")

    finite_start = start if start is not None else NEG_INF
    finite_end = end if end is not None else POS_INF
    duration = (end - start) if (start is not None and end is not None) else None
    is_unbounded = (start is None or end is None)

    return {
        "finite_start": finite_start,
        "finite_end": finite_end,
        "duration": duration,
        "is_unbounded": is_unbounded
    }
ref_test:
def test_interval_bounds():
    res = compute_interval_duration_and_bounds(100, 250)
    assert res["finite_start"] == 100
    assert res["finite_end"] == 250
    assert res["duration"] == 150
    assert not res["is_unbounded"]

    res_unbounded = compute_interval_duration_and_bounds(50, None)
    assert res_unbounded["finite_start"] == 50
    assert res_unbounded["duration"] is None
    assert res_unbounded["is_unbounded"]

    raised = False
    try:
        compute_interval_duration_and_bounds(300, 100)
    except ValueError:
        raised = True
    assert raised
